analogs.covers: Life: owns its stretch of river, fishes, guards it fiercely, tolerates rivals at the great falls
Water behaviour: the tyrant of its water that lunges at intruders and kills rival crocodilians

headline: A grizzly that owns its stretch of river and fights like a saltwater crocodile, then relaxes with its rivals at the great falls.

setting.label: Swamp and jungle rivers
setting.note: Claims medium water sources in Stillwater Bog, the Mudflats, Twisted Forest, the Volcano Islands and Redwood Wind; the territory ends 10 body lengths from the water. Neutral gathering and courtship at Triad Falls, Wollemi Forest and Grand Falls.

playsLike: You are an Apex semi-aquatic carnivore, solitary or in a bonded pair. Inside your claimed territory you are selfishly aggressive: you shadow intruders along the waterline, display your sail, roar, then lunge. You hunt alone, up to Apex, but only in your territory (fish, Leedsichthys and Tylosaurus anywhere), and you kill or expel Deinosuchus and Sarcosuchus on sight. You migrate to Triad Falls to court and bask with other Spinosaurus in peace. You adopt Suchomimus. Slow on land (sprint 700 for 45 s), strong in the water.

why.text: Claims a medium water source and everything within 10 body lengths of it. Grizzlies claim prime fishing spots the same way (official inspiration: grizzly bears).
At Triad Falls territoriality is switched off and Spinosaurus bask, court and relax together, much as grizzlies share the salmon falls.
Sees every invader of its water as competition and lunges from the water to drive it away, as saltwater crocodiles do (official inspiration).
Deinosuchus and Sarcosuchus are killed or expelled as quickly as possible. Big crocodilians don't tolerate rivals in their water.
Apex tier, 6,000 combat weight, 1,100 HP; water cruise 500 and sprint 750 for 167 s.

notLike: Grizzlies roam widely to hunt; Spinosaurus may hunt only in its claimed water territory (fish, Leedsichthys and Tylosaurus excepted).
Crocodiles don't adopt; Spinosaurus adopts Suchomimus of any age.
